item.title: TxDOT reports traffic delays on NB I-27 near 45th Ave
item.description: The Texas Department of Transportation Amarillo Division reported that drivers can expect traffic delays in the area of northbound I-27 near 45th Avenue due to a crash.

item.title: Let's Talk About It: Clint Brakebill, award winning sports broadcaster
item.description: Award winning sports broadcaster, Clint Brakebill, is going out on top. After more than a decade of working as Sports Director at KAMR Local 4, Brakebill will be signing off this month and heading to Anna, Texas.

item.title: Multiple lawsuits filed in Windy Deuce Fire from Feb. 2024
item.description: More than 50 people impacted by the Feb. 2024 Windy Duece Fire has filed a combined four lawsuits in Federal Court.

item.title: Oil prices drop by more than $40 per barrel from dramatic early morning rise
item.description: Crude oil futures opened at $115.62/barrel on Monday morning, a significant increase from Friday's close of $91.27/barrel, due to shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz caused by US military operations in Iran.

item.title: City of Guymon reports traffic congestion due to closed railroad crossings
item.description: Texas County Emergency Management and the City of Guymon reported that all railroad crossings in the city are closed causing traffic congestion on Hurliman.

item.title: Gruver falls in state semifinals against Lipan
item.description: AMARILLO, Texas (KAMR/KCIT) — Tonight, the Gruver Greyhounds faced Lipan in the 2A Div. II state semifinals. Here's the score: Lipan 63 Gruver 53. For the latest Amarillo news and regional updates, check with MyHighPlains.com and tune in to KAMR Local 4 News at 5:00, 6:00, and 10:00 p.m. and Fox 14 News at 9:00 p.m. CST.

item.title: Randall County Sheriff's Office investigating report of person driving off Palo Duro Canyon State Park
item.description: The Randall County Sheriff's Department responded to a call of an individual who had driven a vehicle off a cliff at Palo Duro Canyon.

item.title: Election results on the High Plains: March 3, 2026 primary elections
item.description: Communities around the Texas Panhandle and High Plains are set to make their voices heard on March 3 by voting on federal, statewide and local candidate primaries, as well as other ballot questions.

item.title: Fire in Gray County, 2,000 acres burned; 25% contained
item.description: Multiple fire departments are responding to a wildfire south of Lefors.
